title: Focus Wall — Stay connected. Scroll with intention.
audience: LinkedIn developers, students, recruiters, and people fighting doomscrolling

scenes.copy: You opened Instagram for one message.
Keep the people. Remove the trap.
Choose a daily limit. Count only actual short-form viewing.
The feed stops. Your connections don't.
No ads. No Instagram login. No cloud tracking.
Stay connected. Scroll with intention. View on GitHub.
